content: in november 2020 a civil case was heard in the klaipėda district court involving a marriage applicant mr lp and a defendant ms as the court made a final decision regarding the division of property in a divorce case the defendant was awarded an apartment and ordered to pay the applicant compensation the text discusses three aspects of the case establishing the balance of assets deviation of equal shares between spouses and the division of shareable property the applicant sought the dissolution of the marriage division of matrimonial property and compensation for their share and costs the court considered the best interests of the children and the financial situation of the parties the court also addressed the jurisdiction of lithuanian courts in deciding on the division of property located in ireland the court allocated costs based on the success of each partys claims ultimately the court awarded the apartment to ms as ordered her to pay compensation to mr lp and dismissed the remaining requests made by mr lp
